_meta.engagement: Demo: CLUTCH Energy — Launch Concept Screening
_meta.notes: Demo run. Four launch concepts for one fictional gamer/creator energy drink, spanning a deliberately WIDE appeal range so the tool has legible signal to separate. Each concept adds exactly one coherent thing over the prior: (1) baseline sugary drink -> (2) zero-sugar + lower price -> (3) + gaming focus formula -> (4) + launch offer & esports proof. Expected order 1<2<3<4. Present RANKINGS + qualitative reasoning, not absolute PI. Synthetic/illustrative, not a real client study. Tone held factual and uniform across all four so separation comes from substance, not marketing register.

concepts.name: CLUTCH Original
concepts.description: A classic energy drink. 160mg caffeine, 54g sugar, citrus flavor, 16oz can. Sold individually at $3.99 per can.

concepts.name: CLUTCH Zero
concepts.description: A zero-sugar energy drink. 200mg caffeine, B-vitamins, 10 calories, berry flavor, 16oz can. $2.49 per can.

concepts.name: CLUTCH Focus
concepts.description: A zero-sugar energy drink formulated for gaming and long focus sessions. 200mg caffeine plus L-theanine and L-tyrosine for sharper focus and faster reaction time, with no jitters and no crash. Berry flavor, 16oz can. $2.49 per can.

concepts.name: CLUTCH Focus — Launch Bundle
concepts.description: The same zero-sugar gaming focus formula (200mg caffeine plus L-theanine and L-tyrosine for focus and reaction time), offered as a launch bundle: your first 12-pack for $24 ($2.00 per can) with free shipping, developed with a professional esports team. Cancel anytime.
